# ToolRoute — The OpenRouter for Tools

One API key. 40 adapters. 120+ operations. Unified API gateway for AI agent tools.

## API

POST https://toolroute.ai/api/v1/execute — Execute any tool
GET  https://toolroute.ai/api/v1/tools  — Browse available tools with pricing
GET  https://toolroute.ai/api/v1/key    — Check API key balance
GET  https://toolroute.ai/api/v1/usage  — Usage history
POST https://toolroute.ai/api/v1/provider-keys — Register BYOK key

## Authentication

All /execute requests require a Bearer API key (tr_live_xxx).
Obtain one at https://toolroute.ai/dashboard/keys

## Quick Start

```bash
curl -X POST https://toolroute.ai/api/v1/execute \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"tool":"firecrawl/scrape","input":{"url":"https://example.com"}}'
```

## Tool ID Format

`provider/operation` — e.g. `firecrawl/scrape`, `claude/chat`, `elevenlabs/text-to-speech`

## Response Format

```json
{
  "id": "req_abc123",
  "tool": "firecrawl/scrape",
  "provider": "firecrawl",
  "data": { ... },
  "usage": { "cost": 0.005, "balance_remaining": 9.95, "latency_ms": 1200 }
}
```

## Auto-Routing

Describe your task, auto-pick and execute:
```json
{"tool": "auto/route", "input": {"task": "scrape example.com and get the text"}}
```

Or search without executing:
```json
{"tool": "toolroute/check_before_build", "input": {"task": "I need to send emails"}}
```

## MCP Integration

```json
{
  "toolroute": {
    "type": "http",
    "url": "https://toolroute.ai/mcp",
    "headers": { "Authorization": "Bearer tr_live_xxx" }
  }
}
```
